hero.tagline: In the League, every legend starts small. But only the greatest clubs reach eternity.
hero.subtitle: Manage your club, scout unique athletes, and compete in PvP — USDC base economy.

club.title: YOUR CLUB
club.desc: Create your club and upgrade stadium, training, treasury, and trophy room. USDC comes from squad earnings, sponsorships, and deposits.

scout.title: SCOUT
scout.desc: Recruit athletes with server-side rarity rolls. Each scout costs 2 USDC.

marketplace.title: MARKETPLACE
marketplace.desc: Buy and sell players from other clubs in the league.

pvp.title: PVP
pvp.desc: Face other clubs in real-time matches via Socket.IO.

1.title: CREATE ACCOUNT
1.desc: Free email signup. Get 1 Common athlete (FT) when you register.

2.title: FOUND YOUR CLUB
2.desc: Pick a club name and start earning USDC with your squad on the pitch.

3.title: SCOUT ATHLETES
3.desc: Spend 2 USDC per player. Rarity rolled server-side — Common to Legendary.

4.title: UPGRADE BUILDINGS
4.desc: Invest USDC in upgrades. Cost scales per level — plan your economy.

5.title: MARKET & PVP
5.desc: Trade players on the marketplace and challenge other managers.

economy.title: USDC ECONOMY
economy.subtitle: Real MVP values — USDC as the base economy (phase 1)

walletActivity.title: USDC ACTIVITY
walletActivity.subtitle: Latest 10 confirmed on-chain deposits and withdrawals (public data, masked wallets)

cta.joinLeague: Create your account, found your club, and make your first scout in minutes.
